relationships.subject: HO-1
relationships.evidence_quote: Heme oxygenase-1 (HO-1), a key antioxidant enzyme that extensively regulates cellular OS and inflammatory responses, holds promising therapeutic potential for chronic pain due to its significant anti-inflammatory and neuroprotective effects.

key_findings: Review of HO-1 as a therapeutic target for chronic pain, with drugs from 2020-2026 and noted toxicity concerns.
